mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Micromancer: "When this creature enters, you may search your library for an instant or
# sorcery card with mana value 1, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle."
# M21 Fierce Empath's verified sentence (B2b-fierce-empath-etb: OptionalEffect(Seq(SEARCH to your
# hand, REVEAL 1, SHUFFLE))) with the searched kind "instant or sorcery card" (FDN Mocking Sprite's
# FOr of TYPE_EQ) and "mana value 1" as mana value at least 1 and at most 1 (CMC_GE 1 and CMC_LE 1,
# the two existing thresholds; a mana value is an integer, CR 202.3).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.SEARCH, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(
                            children=(
                                FOr(
                                    children=(
                                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Instant'),
                                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Sorcery'),
                                    ),
                                ),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CMC_GE, count=QConst(value=1)),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CMC_LE, count=QConst(value=1)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
                    ),
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
                }),
                A(Verb.REVEAL, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=1)}),
                A(Verb.SHUFFLE, {'zone': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU)}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]
